title: Concrete CoordinatorChannel implementation and B adapter handoff
statement: The concrete module, strict types, adapter example, fault/capacity matrix, independent consumer and docs are published. B has not adopted it, so the old runner-service waiter maps still exist and results I9-I12 are not PASS.

invariants: producer fixed at construction from the trusted registration and frozen; request identity is never taken from the request's own claim
generation 0 -> 1 on first bind, CAS monotonic, safe-integer bounded, failure leaves the current lease unchanged
exactly one live lease; replacement atomically fenced, old receive/close cannot touch the replacement
facts resend original factId and body within the unrefreshed deadline and wait for A's idempotent durable ACK
payload reads re-read the same immutable reference with the same correlation id across leases
each native intent needs a fresh guard decision; pending writes become indeterminate on rebind/close and old allowed replies are never reused
single settlement under timeout/reply, close/reply, send-failure/reply races; late replies return false
capacity and byte bounds refuse before send; rejected requests never reach the transport
errors carry bounded ids/status and a stable reason, never payload values, credentials, absolute private paths or stacks
close distinguishes lease detach from module close and claims no physical writer quiescence

results.content: Concrete three-callback module on one controller/one connection with constructor, CAS bind, recordFact/readPayload/beforeNativeWrite, strict types and adapter example
Same controller from client A to client B with durable-ACK sink, immutable payload re-read and fresh guard over one chatty scenario plus five focused rebind cases
Compilable RunnerAttachChannel adapter, exact runner-service replacement points, deletion order for the three waiter maps and post-adoption regression inputs
Fault, capacity, late-reply and close matrix with single settlement, capacity recovery and secret-free diagnostics, plus direct actual-module strict compilation
Reusable module plus operations docs, B handoff, H independent consumer guidance, compatibility guard and this status file
notReached: H executed its own independent consumer in its own tree

handoff.main: Module implements the 0068 interface unchanged; no contracts edit requested. Further failure-class semantics would need a minimal RFC.
handoff.B: Replace three registrations (:144/:150/:151) and four receive branches (:325/:334/:342/:348), delete the maps, close via channel.close in the documented order, then run the original normal chain and rebind regressions.
handoff.H: Copy apps/runner/test/attach-channel/independent-consumer.test.ts into its own tree; report defects with owner classification instead of editing I or B sources.
